We’ve been so grateful to Liberty Animal Clinic for the ongoing care they’ve given Molley with her health issues. From the very first appointment, the vets took time to actually explain what was going on instead of rushing through it, and they’ve stayed on top of every follow-up since.

The whole staff has been wonderful — patient with our questions, gentle with Molley and always quick to respond when we’ve called with concerns between visits. It’s clear the whole team genuinely cares, not just about the medical side but about how anxious pets (and owners!) can get.

Managing a chronic/ongoing condition is stressful, but Liberty Animal Clinic has made it so much easier. Highly recommend them to anyone looking for a vet who treats your pet like family.

Some of the staff are shockingly unprofessional and mean-spirited. Pricing and costs seem to zig-zag, depending on who you talk to and what you look like and how severe the need is.
I regret ever bringing my cat here, and wish I had paid the slightly higher price for a real, legitimate veterinary office. At the time, I didn't know better, and this place was close. Waste of time and money, and much of what I was told by the staff was contradicted by more than one established, seasoned veterinarian. Liberty Clinic is the airline equivalent of Spirit or Frontier. If you love your cat (or dog, lizard, bird, rabbit, etc), pay the slightly higher price for an honest, straightforward, empathetic, legitimate veterinary clinic.
Never took my call , they just let you on the phone  , very rude

I found a stray kitten and made the mistake of going back to liberty clinic. We didn’t see Dr Dobson, who is wonderful, but the new female doctor. She looked at my kitten and said she thinks the kitten had an upper respiratory infection and sent me home with ointment for his eyes but no antibiotics. She recommended we come back next week for shots and stated to give her steam baths to help with congestion.

From the beginning, the kitten was mouth breathing and she said this was due to the infection. Come to find out a few days later that the kitten has pneumonia and is likely to die. I wish the doctor did a more comprehensive examination on the cat and that would’ve saved me 7k and the kitten would’ve survived. I’ve brought all four of my pets to this clinic and will never go back again.

Update: my kitten passed away and I can’t help but think if I didn’t take her here, she’d still be alive.

As a response to the generic message the clinic sent: not much to discuss. You should have better vets at the clinic who want to spend more than 5 seconds with pets.
Took my daughter’s cat here it was fast and easy.

Love Dobson he is honest and very friendly. Takes his time trying to teach you along the way and explain each process of the evaluation.

I recently switched to this vet clinic, and after 3 visits, I’m extremely disappointed with my overall experience. During my first visit, I was upset because the appointment felt rushed the doctor barely examined my dog and quickly walked in and out. On my second visit, I specifically requested Dr. D, and that was the only time I felt comfortable. However, even then, the vet techs who performed the bloodwork seemed inexperienced in how they handled my dog. Getting test results has also been a constant struggle I always have to call multiple times to get updates, and when I finally do, the techs (who aren’t qualified to interpret results) are the ones relaying the information. It’s incredibly frustrating.
My most recent visit was by far the worst. The female doctor who saw my dog appeared unprepared and even seemed unsure why I was there. I had to remind her multiple times to check my dog’s anal glands, which she finally did, but now my dog is scooting worse than before. She also claimed my dog had a flea which I know isn’t true. I immediately treated him, and after checking thoroughly at home and with a groomer, there were no fleas. I feel she was dishonest.
To make matters worse, they took my dog to the back for bloodwork something I’ve repeatedly explained traumatizes him due to a past experience. When he came home, he was scared, broke out in a rash, and has been constantly itching ever since. I feel like I paid a lot of money only for my dog’s condition to worsen. I’m very upset that I now have to search for another vet. While I really liked Dr. D, I don’t believe other doctors here should be seeing patients if they’re not confident in what they’re doing. My dog means everything to me, and this was by far the worst experience we’ve had. The wait times have also gotten much longer compared to previous visits. The front desk staff member is kind and patient, though I can tell he gets overwhelmed at times which I understand.
I would sincerely appreciate a call from Dr. D regarding this situation, as my dog is still in discomfort and I need to decide how to move forward. For other pet owners: please make sure you know which doctor you’re seeing before your appointment, and do not allow them to take your pet to the back alone  you deserve to know what’s happening at all times. t’s sad that I even have to write this review, but it’s impossible to speak with Dr. D personally, which makes this even more frustrating.
I've been coming to this vet for years and I'm very happy with the service. Their prices are fair and treat my fur babies with respect
Saved 2 of my dogs , the doctor is very friendly very professional would 100% recommend. He also tries not to break your pockets !

Staff who are young were great! However i took my dog to get an allergy/cytopoint shot and she did. I waited a couple days with no change to her itching. I called back to the clinic to tell that the shot was not working and, they said you can bring her back to evaluate her and they wanted to charge me $75 for the visit when clearly the shot did nothing for my dog. She's had this shot done before and always worked so now  I have to wonder are they being watered down or they didn't administer enough for the weight of my fifteen pound doggy. Very disappointed and never will I go back!!!!
Very attentive. Not expensive. Always helpful. In the language.
Staff and crew are very kind and very respectful as well and the doctor h is very good

I found this place when I lived in Ozone Park at the referral of my mother in law. I have since moved to Flushing and while there are multiple vet offices right nearby, the $60 cab ride each way to Dr. Dodson is worth it to me.
Felt like my kitty got traumatized by it. He is afraid to go out and took a long time to recover. Couldn’t go to the bathroom for a week after being nuttered

I’ve been going to this clinic for years. I see the difference now and when I first started going. The service was good and reasonable prices, they showed interest in your pets care. I see now it’s all about charging and not the proper pet care . They are referring you to different specialists to keep the business going. I will no longer be taking my pet to this clinic.
The service from everyone there was excellent. I went to have my dog ​​operated on for a lump, and the next day he was operated on. It was much cheaper than other places I visited.

This is such a good veterinarian office. They are super nice and always make sure my dog is doing great. Two years ago, I thought i was going to lose my fur baby because I couldn't figure out why she stopped eating, and after a very expensive visit, I found this place thanks to a friend. The vet just looked at her blood work from the er and diagnosed her without trying to run my pockets for more money. He gave me 3 simple meds to give her, and she's been great ever since. They are also pretty affordable. Sometimes it's hard to reach them by phone but it is a small place with one receptionist. Kudos to this place!

Called on phone before booking appointment and I asked the price of first time patient wellness exam. The lady on the phone told me $55 only for them to tell me when it was time to pay that it is $75. I found that very annoying cause why lie to lure patients in

They don’t seem to have any sense of urgency. I’ve been waiting a week for the results of my cat’s ultrasound. She’s still vomiting and having diarrhea after the medicine they gave. I’ve tried calling them for an update, they put me on hold for 10 minutes, and then they just said the doctor has to call me to give the results… I’m still waiting for him to call.

My cat is sick and needs help, but they don’t seem to care. I only had two visits so far (one of them for the ultrasound) and they already charged me over $1K, and they don’t have a payment plan. I am furious! What am I even paying for??
When I first got the blood test results from the first visit, they barely even gave me an explanation for the results. I just uploaded the results to ChatGPT and got more information on what is going on with my cat than I’ve gotten from this vet in a week.

The only person who seems to being trying to help me is the lovely receptionist Robin. She seems to actually be concerned about my cat’s situation. Unfortunately, her hands are tied, but she’s trying to get someone to help me.

It was a good place to get the Pet Travel Certificate (for a cat) for an international flight; it cost me $341 even though I presented the vaccinations and deworming certificate dated two days prior to my arrival from Mexico. Elsewhere, it was over $500, and I should add that I was missing a health certificate from the veterinarian, which they asked for at the airport and hadn't provided.
